notes.title: 1.0.8 - Localization (Bonjour!) And new Demon Textures!
notes.content:
1.0.8 Adds so much more inclusivitity and I will add more languages in coming updates!

All dialogue within Saving Grace Has had a complete overhaul with the added support for localization.
Allowing users to change language on the fly whenever they choose!

[b]Localization[/b]
The languages translated by a human are:
-English
-French
-Polish
-Russian

The other languages have been AI-Generated. If you would like to help the Localization efforts for Saving Grace, Please Contact me Via The discord pinned in the Community Hub, Twitter or my official support email!

[b]Demon Textures[/b]
Along with Localization. Saving Grace has had yet another graphical overhaul. These changes include:
-Plethora of Updated and randomly assigned textures for the demons! To spice up the visuals yet again!

The original texture for the demons was not very good. And now I feel the new textures are leagues above the old. I hope you guys feel the same way!

[b]Visuals[/b]
With this update, there has been an increase in atmosphere. Hell now has hellish fog littering the atmosphere so that the players feel like they are more in hell. Along with some creepy ambient music that will make your hairs stand on end!

Thank you so much for all the people who have purchased Saving Grace! You are making this so fantastic!

And I hope this update adds move inclusivity world wide! So everyone can enjoy Saving Grace!

Don't See your language in the supported list? Please Contact me! I would love to add your language to Saving Grace!

-Thomas09 Games.

notes.title: 1.0.7 Introduces revamped voice acting!
notes.content:
1.0.7 has made the voice acting in the dream worlds more appropiate. Before the voice lines were dull, flat and just something i wasn't happy about. But now I have re-recorded; re-edited them to make them so much more impactful! And i hope the players of Saving Grace finds them more appealing!

1.0.7 also fixed a bug in the first dream world. where notes would not leave your screen until you looked at another object. This has been fixed.

I have also entered a tool tip on the first dream level to remind people to press tab so they know that they must do!

Added one new achievement.

The boss fire-orbs ability has had a graphical over-haul aswell. Making them must more "evil" looking.

And thats it. Thank you for the continued support and I hope you're all still enjoying Saving Grace!

Thank you!

-Thomas09 Games

notes.title: Saving Grace 1.0.6! Big and Small changes!
notes.content:
Over the last couple of days, There has been some changes to Saving Grace. Down below will be a TLDR and a full list of whats changed / fixed. I hope everyone is enjoying Saving Grace so far!

[b]TLDR:[/b]
All UI is now compatible with an Xbox Controller.
BIG changes to the boss fight
Added various things around the game to bring more immersion.


[b]Run Down List:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed issues with some UI not displaying for Xbox controller input.
[*] Re-edited the beginning video of the game to give it a more "game / flashback" vibe.
[*] Added skipping functionality for the beginning video.
[*] Added random sound events throughout the first dream level.
[*] Added a new scary event in the greenhouse for the first dream level.
[*] Amended first dream level objectives book, to make it clearer what you need to do.
[*] Fixed some doors not opening / opening correctly in the first dream world.
[*] Fixed a bug where you couldn't look directly down to pick up objects in the ghost town.
[*] Added more enemies to the ghost town.
[*] Demon surfing is no longer in the game. It was a bug and it's now been patched. I'm sorry for anyone who enjoyed it. I know i did.
[*]  The hidden weapon in the boss fight is now AOE!
[*] The boss arm attack now damages the player as it should.
[*] Revamped the hidden weapon VFX and the boss fire ability VFX.
[*] After dashing, your movement stance will default to sprinting. To give more dynamic to skill.
[*] General optimisations.
[*] New Hidden Achievement!
[/list]

I believe thats everything. It's been a long few days. Please voice your opinions if you like / don't like Saving Grace and tell me why! Join the Discord to discuss about Saving Grace! I'd love to hear your opinions!

Thank you.

Happy Gaming.

notes.title: The Pre-Launch Update!
notes.content:
Steam still has not approved Saving Grace for release. I assume this is due to the holidays and in conjuction with Corona Virus. But rest assured. Saving Grace will release within the next few days! Sorry Once again.

The Pre-Launch update provides alternate endings for the game! Previously, if the player chose the "wrong" option, the game would loop until you chose the "correct" ending!

 [list]
[*] Saving Grace now has two endings!
[*] Added more enemies throughout the levels
[*] Made the hidden weapon in the boss level be more obtainable and easier to use
[*] Performance Optimization
[*] Added film grain to the beginning video to give it more of a "Game" feel.
[*] Added more Real time demon slicing for one of the endings!
[*] Added more dialogue for the ending/s
[/list]

Known Issues:
[list]
[*] If you run into demons, depending on their current velocity; you will be "Teleported" on top of them. *#Surfing* - This will be fixed in a near future patch.
[/list]
